info.name: VisionInspect-AI API
info.description: All 29 operations of the VisionInspect-AI FastAPI backend (generated from /openapi.json), plus a Negative tests folder. Select the **VisionInspect-AI local** environment, type the demo passwords into it, then run **Auth > Login (quality engineer)**. Requests that create, change or delete data are skipped unless `allowWrites` is `true`. See postman/README.md.
